method: Bounded static source inspection; original file bytes checked against pinned Git tree blob IDs. No upstream execution.
scope: The file ranges listed below cover the architecture-relevant integration boundary. This is not a line-by-line review of the entire repository or a security certification.

limitations.license: No root project LICENSE/COPYING in the complete pinned tree; missing licensing is a completed audit finding, not permission to copy.
limitations.tests: Inspected evaluation code is recorded in the evidence manifest. It was not executed and does not establish unit-test coverage, deployment security or Dzoka retrieval accuracy.

files.observation: Integration-boundary source excerpts inspected; conclusions are scoped in the linked canonical report. No upstream code executed or imported.
